title: Anemia in the setting of organ insult, systemic disease, and aging

units.name: Introduction
units.assessment: Can you name the organ-failure states in which anemia is common and say which mechanism dominates in each — erythropoietin deficit, inflammatory iron restriction, blood loss, or shortened red cell survival?

lesson.note: Candidates were introductory lab-science and USMLE-style overviews of anemia in general, plus one lecture on neurologic manifestations of hematologic disease; nothing frames anemia as a comorbidity of organ failure and systemic disease, which is what this introduction sets up.

units.name: Anemia in chronic kidney disease
units.assessment: Can you state the hemoglobin range an ESA should target in CKD, name the iron parameters checked before escalating dose, and explain how HIF-prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors differ from ESAs mechanistically and in cardiovascular safety?

lesson.title: New Treatment Strategies for Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease: Where Do They Fit?
lesson.why: The most current candidate: it positions the HIF-prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors against conventional ESAs and iron, which is where practice in anemia of CKD has actually changed.

drills.name: Guideline body on the new paradigm
drills.title: KDIGO Optimal Anemia Management in CKD: A New Paradigm in Treatment?

drills.name: KDIGO conference on anemia targets
drills.title: KDIGO Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease

drills.name: Consequences of undertreating
drills.title: Anemia of CKD: Consequences of Missing the Boat

units.name: Anemia in heart failure
units.assessment: How is functional iron deficiency defined in heart failure, and what did the intravenous iron trials show for symptoms, quality of life, hospitalization and mortality — and why did oral iron fail?

lesson.title: Iron Deficiency in Heart Failure: Why, When, and How to Treat
lesson.channel: St. Michael's Hospital Cardiology Grand Rounds
lesson.why: A cardiology grand rounds structured exactly as this section is: why iron matters in heart failure, whom to test, what the ferritin and saturation thresholds are, and how to dose intravenous iron.

drills.name: Longer CME on the same question
drills.title: Demystifying Diagnosis and Treatment of Iron Deficiency in Heart Failure

drills.name: Trialist's summary of the evidence
drills.title: Iron deficiency in patients with heart failure - Prof Ewa Jankowska

units.name: Anemia in cancer
units.assessment: Can you decide when a patient with chemotherapy-induced anemia should receive intravenous iron, an ESA, or transfusion, and state the restrictions on ESA use during curative-intent treatment?

lesson.title: WATCH NOW - Infusing Renewed Hope into Cancer-related Anemia with Intravenous Iron
lesson.why: An accredited session on cancer-related anemia that works through functional iron deficiency during chemotherapy, when intravenous iron alone corrects the anemia, and where erythropoiesis-stimulating agents and transfusion still belong.

drills.name: Anemia and thrombocytopenia in oncology practice
drills.title: AnemAnemia and Thrombocytopenia Basics - N. Vogler - 20240619

drills.name: Preoperative anemia in a solid tumour
drills.title: A Practical Approach to Better Address Anemia in Gynecologic Oncology

drills.name: A guideline author on where the field is going
drills.title: Matti Aapro, MD: Emerging Topics in Anemia and Cancer

units.name: Anemia in liver and gastrointestinal diseases
units.assessment: Can you explain why cirrhosis produces anemia through several simultaneous mechanisms, and list the gastrointestinal diagnoses that must be excluded once iron deficiency is found in an adult?

lesson.title: Gastrointestinal Disorders & Anemia
lesson.why: A specialist CME talk on anemia arising from gastrointestinal disease — bleeding, malabsorption, inflammation and post-bariatric deficiency — which is the bulk of this section.

units.name: Anemia in chronic pulmonary pathologies
units.assessment: Why is anemia rather than secondary polycythemia common in COPD, and what prognostic weight do anemia and a raised red cell distribution width carry in that population?

lesson.title: Advanced Pulmonology Clinic | Anemia : Thinking beyond the usual
lesson.why: A pulmonology clinical session devoted to anemia in lung disease, which is the only candidate that treats it as a comorbidity of chronic respiratory illness rather than a general anemia topic.

drills.name: Data from severe COPD exacerbations
drills.title: Anemia in severe COPD exacerbation - Video Abstract 111758

units.name: Anemia in the elderly
units.assessment: In an older adult with anemia, can you name the roughly one-third of cases that stay unexplained after workup, and describe how nutritional, renal and clonal marrow causes are excluded before that label is applied?

lesson.title: Anemia in the Elderly
lesson.why: A dedicated specialist lecture on anemia in older adults covering the nutritional, renal, inflammatory and unexplained categories and how they are separated.

drills.title: Anemia in the Elderly by Dr. Cecilia Acuin
